state.description: GTC will turn Cavender Drive into a 500/230kV station looping in the Villa Rica - Union City 500kV line, installing a 2016 MVA auto transformer.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
